<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/push_project_git/{guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Pushes the project's cloud remote up to date, using the acting
user's own SSH key. By default pushes the current user's dev clone (its
own main only, which may lag the hub - the hub itself is kept current
automatically on every commit, see GITutils._sync_to_hub_if_clone).
With `hub=true` (the project card/popout's project-level Push button),
pushes the hub instead - every pending commit it has, regardless of
which clone or structural edit put it there. With no remote configured,
a clone push is just a safety-net sync of the clone to the hub; a hub
push fails outright (nothing to push to). See GITutils.push_project/
push_hub_to_cloud.
